con.text: Asha, the archangel who protects Bant, leaves it after ensuring that the world would have protection and order in her absence.
During the splitting of Alara she dies at the hands of Malfegor, leaving the throne of Bant's angels empty, and Malfegor is exiled to Grixis.
In her battle with Malfegor her sword is broken into twelve pieces, buried under the Twelve Trees of Valeron.
